component.name: Drover
component.summary: A native workspace for Herdr-powered agents, terminals, worktrees, and live sessions

description.p: Drover is an independent graphical client for Herdr, providing the Herdr workspace, tab, pane, terminal, and agent experience as a native desktop interface while keeping Herdr as the only engine and runtime authority. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Herdr project.

Host access: Drover runs the host Herdr CLI, connects to Herdr's Unix sockets, controls host terminals, and uses host SSH tools. This Flatpak bundle therefore requests host command execution (flatpak-spawn --host) and is not a security boundary between the application and the host.
